text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...I don't know.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"No... We should be arriving at the shop 
by now. Forget the shop, there isn't even 
a soul in sight."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Even though it's lunchtime, there are no 
stalls... Does that mean everything's 
mobile?"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So, the locals know where the shops 
gather, and that's where they all hang 
out... or something?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I don't know.
The story traces back to a few days prior—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Trainer, do you like takoyaki?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: "Ah, forgive me. I got ahead of myself."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"From here on, we will run through the 
Twinkle Series together."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That's why I wanted to do something to 
liven things up for our debut race.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"And then, Tama told me about a delicious 
takoyaki place in town."

It seems Oguri Cap put some thought in her 
own way into what she should do leading up 
to her debut.
choice_data_list: Still, why did it have to be takoyaki?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"‘Takoyaki is round and super chewy! It's 
perfect for building up momentum!’ 
...apparently."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I've thoroughly memorized the shop's 
location. Leave it to me, you're in good 
hands.

—While feeling anxious about Oguri Cap's 
boundless enthusiasm, I went out with her 
anyway, but...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Could it be that I have lost my way 
once again?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No, that can't be. I made sure to 
double-check with Tama—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—Listen up, Oguri, I'm gonna repeat this 
one more time, alright?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Once you leave the station, head straight 
down the main avenue and turn at the 
corner by 'Mile Supermarket.'

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"If you ever get lost, use 'Akko's Parking 
Lot' as your landmark."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
See? Easy, right? Pretty good, huh? That's 
"Akko's Motor Pool" for ya!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yet I couldn't find the landmark... I kept 
searching, and somehow ended up all the 
way out here...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Akko-san's motor pool... Where on earth 
could it be...?

...It seems there was a misunderstanding 
between Oguri Cap and Tamamo Cross.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"That parking lot over there"...? Did it 
mean something like that?

When Tamamo Cross says "akko," she means 
"over there," and "motor pool" means 
"parking lot." Apparently, some regions 
talk like that.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I see... There certainly was a large 
parking lot along the way.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, let's head back that far 
for now and..."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ……Hm? How am I supposed to get back?
(Grrrrrr...)

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...My stomach cried out in agony. Yearning 
for... takoyaki...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Is this really where it ends for 
me?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Even though I haven't lived up to the 
expectations of everyone back home yet...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Before I can fulfill my dream of 
succeeding in the Central... is this 
where... it all ends...?
(Grrrrrrrrrrrrrr...)
choice_data_list: Let's look for a nearby shop today.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...! That would be a big help...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... It's all because of my own 
inadequacy.
choice_data_list: Let's go get takoyaki another time.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Without a doubt. This time, I will 
win...!

Oguri Cap's fighting spirit burns quietly. 
With this momentum, she'll surely power 
through all the way to her debut.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: "Takoyaki... Round and chewy...!"

...From here on, let's begin the legend of 
Oguri Cap!
